## 校队第二轮选拔结果公示

各位社员：校队第二轮选拔已圆满完成，感谢各位同学的积极参与。现将结果公示如下，以下 6 名同学正式成为**武汉外国语学校乒乓球校队 2026 级队员**：

| 班级 | 姓名 |
|---|---|
| 高二(9)班 | 王天森 |
| 高一(7)班 | 徐耀鹏 |
| 高一(6)班 | 王禹涵 |
| 高一(4)班 | 冯秋源 |
| 高一(10)班 | 马钰恒 |
| 高一(11)班 | 魏子越 |

第二轮选拔采用三局两胜制，由社长及副社长担任选拔人员，共进行了 11 场比赛。恭喜以上同学，也感谢所有参与选拔的同学——能站上球台就已经很了不起。

新队员的比赛记录已计入社团积分排名，大家可以在排行榜上找到他们。
excerpt_en: Round 2 of the school team selection is complete. Six students have joined the WFLS table tennis school team: WANG Tiansen (Grade 11, Class 9), XU Yaopeng (Grade 10, Class 7), WANG Yuhan (Class 6), FENG Qiuyuan (Class 4), MA Yuheng (Class 10) and WEI Ziyue (Class 11).
content_en:
## 2026 School Team Selection: Round 2 Results

Dear club members, round 2 of the school team selection is complete. Thank you to everyone who took part. Here are the results — the following six students are now official members of the **2026 cohort of the WFLS table tennis school team**:

| Class | Name |
|---|---|
| Grade 11, Class 9 | WANG Tiansen |
| Grade 10, Class 7 | XU Yaopeng |
| Grade 10, Class 6 | WANG Yuhan |
| Grade 10, Class 4 | FENG Qiuyuan |
| Grade 10, Class 10 | MA Yuheng |
| Grade 10, Class 11 | WEI Ziyue |

Round 2 was played as best-of-three against the president and the vice presidents, with 11 matches in total. Congratulations to the new members — and thank you to everyone who tried out; simply stepping up to the table is an achievement in itself.

The new members' match records are already counted in the club ranking, so you can find them on the leaderboard.
